comments.value: N.B.: The user was being provocative and creating a safety issue by sharing a sexually explicit emoji at a Group+ instance advertised publicly and accessible to ages 13+. This wasn't an appropriate private place for provocative behavior among consenting adults and my consent was not gathered at that time, so the offending content was reported and actioned. I'm leaving this comment as a clarification because I find people being judgmental or misunderstanding my reasons for reporting sometimes, while it was necessary to share some information publicly to make this feature request.

details:
When content is actioned (e.g. an emoji is removed for Community Guidelines violations), there seems to be a human factor creating a delay before the user's account status is actioned (suspended) and before the user is disconnected from VRChat after content is actioned.

The notification of content being actioned (removed):

```

2026.05.25 19:17:05 Debug      -  Received Notification: <Notification from username:, sender user id: to usr_6fa4abc5-9952-4a0a-97de-b3598fbf6a5c of type: moderation, id: not_103f8b0c-996e-45f1-9f6a-3ec29379af5d, created at: 05/25/2026 19:17:03 UTC, details: {{}}, type:moderation, m seen:False, message: "The emoji associated with a report you submitted was actioned by the moderation team. This may be as a result of a report you submitted or from the report of another user. Thank you for helping to keep VRChat safe!">

2026.05.25 19:17:05 Debug      -  Received Notification: <Notification from username:, sender user id: to usr_6fa4abc5-9952-4a0a-97de-b3598fbf6a5c of type: moderation, id: not_a7e36127-2455-49a6-9ff4-7e983ad19426, created at: 05/25/2026 19:17:04 UTC, details: {{}}, type:moderation, m seen:False, message: "The emoji associated with a report you submitted was actioned by the moderation team. This may be as a result of a report you submitted or from the report of another user. Thank you for helping to keep VRChat safe!">

```

As soon as the notification was received, I still spotted the offender in the instance and saw the emoji in "Report UI", believing at first no action was taken. But [the notification was duplicated](https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/moderation-report-closed-notifications-are-duplicated), which typically means action was taken or to be taken (no action = 0-1 notifications). I attempted to report the emoji again from Reports UI, but received a response that the emoji was now not found (deleted by Trust & Safety).

```

2026.05.25 19:19:56 Error      -  [API] [1848, 404, Post, -1 https://api.vrchat.cloud/api/1/moderationReports] Abandoning request, because - Emoji not found․

2026.05.25 19:19:56 Error      -  Error submitting report: Emoji not found․

```

Moments later, the offender was disconnected from the instance while talking.

```

2026.05.25 19:20:19 Debug      -  [Behaviour] OnPlayerLeftRoom

2026.05.25 19:20:19 Debug      -  [Behaviour] OnPlayerLeft *** (usr_********-****-****-****-************)

2026.05.25 19:20:19 Debug      -  Removed player ***

2026.05.25 19:20:19 Debug      -  [Behaviour] Destroying ***

```

Bystanders in the instance then started wondering what happened to this offender and moments later received information privately from the offender saying the offender was banned from VRChat for something. (A thumbnail of the offending emoji still remained in the Report UI for an explanation after the disconnection, but the emoji was no longer reportable because it was already actioned.)

Speculatively: This is a feature request for better, more efficient tooling for VRChat's Trust & Safety team to take action on accounts faster and simultaneously when content is removed, to close the gap between the notification and removal of the offender (which was ~3 minutes in this case). Ideally and requested, this time gap would be 0 seconds.
title: Reduce the time gap between "Moderation Report Closed" notification and disconnecting the banned offender from VRChat
